changes.title: Saved creator identity
changes.text: Summoned creatures preserve their creator's offensive-damage origin when saving and loading; ordinary legacy creatures retain their existing behavior.

changes.title: Inherited attack origin
changes.text: Damage attribution follows an explicitly recorded summon creator rather than guessing from friendly alignment.

changes.title: Prismatic image identity
changes.text: New prismatic images record the hero who created them.

changes.title: Earth guardian identity
changes.text: New earth guardians record their wand user's offensive origin.

changes.title: Shadow clone identity
changes.text: New shadow clones retain their hero creator's offensive origin.

changes.title: Spirit hawk identity
changes.text: New spirit hawks retain their hero creator's offensive origin.

changes.title: Ghost identity
changes.text: New Dried Rose ghosts retain their summoning hero's offensive origin.

changes.title: Skeleton identity
changes.text: New necromancer skeletons record the necromancer who summoned them.

changes.title: Dwarf summons identity
changes.text: New Dwarf King subjects retain boss attribution through save/load.

changes.title: Yog summons identity
changes.text: Yog's new summons and fists retain their boss creator's offensive origin.

changes.title: Swarm offspring identity
changes.text: Split swarms inherit their parent's recorded offensive origin.

changes.title: Ghoul offspring identity
changes.text: New ghoul partners inherit their parent's recorded offensive origin.

changes.title: Spawner offspring identity
changes.text: New ripper demons record their spawner's offensive origin.

changes.title: Rat transformation identity
changes.text: Summoned allied rats record their hero creator; transformed rats preserve the original creature's offensive origin.

changes.title: Ownership regressions
changes.text: Added save/load, multi-generation summon, legacy-data, invalid-data and neutral-RNG checks for offensive ownership.

changes.title: Verified artifact staging
changes.text: Staging now checks the exact TEST123 source, test counts, screenshots, package and signing before private delivery.

changes.title: Private delivery tag validation
changes.text: Private delivery verifies identical application inputs when tagging a delivery commit, preserving prior assets and the tested APK.

changes.title: Touch-fix evidence
changes.text: Recorded the successful core and Android touchscreen checks and actual TEST123 delivery.

changes.title: Ownership verification report
changes.text: Recorded the source-ownership foundation, compatibility safeguards, remaining damage paths and build checks.

changes.title: Build verification metadata
changes.text: Updated the exact previous-APK attribution and required test counts for this build.

commentary: I preserved the original creator identity for summoned allies and enemies through save/load. This prepares reliable damage attribution; the three offensive damage sliders remain pending until every damage path is integrated.
